This website is open to my students in the University of Nebraska-Lincoln's STAT 801A course. 

**Course description:** Statistical concepts and statistical methodology useful in descriptive, experimental, and analytical study of biological and other natural phenomena. Practical application of statistics rather than on statistical theory.
